title: The 15 MWP/ICM Workspace Architecture Conventions: Stage Contracts, Output Handoffs, One-Way Dependencies, Checkpoints, and Stage Audits
author: Jake Van Clief (2026; synthesized by Brain Harness)

claims.assertion: Every stage CONTEXT.md must adhere strictly to the 3-section stage contract: Inputs table (Source, File, Scope, Why), Process steps, and Outputs table (Artifact, Location, Format); deviations break autonomous agent execution.

Inter-stage communication must occur solely through files in output/ subfolders (stages/0N-name/output/artifact.md) without stateful orchestrators, ensuring every intermediate deliverable is a human-editable surface.
All directory and stage references must be strictly one-way (if A references B, B must never reference A); bidirectional dependencies cause exponential reference growth as workspaces scale.

Reference docs in the factory are authoritative; agents are strictly forbidden from reading prior run outputs to learn patterns because early outputs are the lowest quality and poison future generations.
